guard/30224.htm.text: Sentry Knight Rayla: May the abyss spare you to its service& I am Rayla, a commander of Sentries, who protects the dignity and honor of Dark Elves.

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30224-1.htm.text: Sentry Knight Rayla: Sentries are guardians who protect the Dark Forest from invaders. We also escort the Tetrarchs and carry out the laws to punish those who have broken the commandments. They say the Elves of light also have guards called Sentinels.
